title: Image publication runbook for release 2.7
text:
# Publication failures in release 2.7

PUB-403 indicates that the image publisher lacks the artifact registry publish permission.

In release 2.7, restarting workers does not repair a registry authorization failure.

Compare the publisher identity policy with the registry publish permission before proposing a mitigation.

A deployment preceding an error spike establishes correlation, not a confirmed root cause.
